name: Kaiinsei Rape Club ~Shojo Ryoujoku no Utage~
original_name: 会員制レイプクラブ　～処女凌辱の宴～
source:
R*pe Club was a members-only website. Users discussed what they did or planned to do, and even uploaded videos. Sometimes they arranged real life gangr*pe parties. The protagonist was a member of this site. When he one day he impulsively tried to contribute with some voyeur photos, he got in trouble and was suspended from school. It was all the fault of Emi Hagiwara, the swim captain. The protagonist was furious.

He was ready to earn his R*pe Club VIP. He decided to r*pe Emi.

With the help of the website's other members, he began plotting his crime.
Can he really do it!?
